title: The Minton's house band
summary: He does not remember Kermit Scott. He played clarinet in the Minton's house group with Nick Fenton, Monk and a drummer, and everybody sat in.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: You reminded me of something else before when you were talking about Walt Lavinsky's brother. You said Kermit. It reminded me of Kermit Scott. A lot of
people talk about from the early sessions at Minton's. What do you remember about him?
He's from San Francisco. He's in San Francisco now,
That's way off somewhere. I -- just about but I don't remember him. At the time I was there --
Who were you playing with them? Were you playing in the house band?
Yeah, with Nick Fenton and Thelonious and the drummer was Harold West sometimes and sometimes it was someone else. Just four pieces.
Yeah. It was no way -- it always ended up to six or seven, nine or ten.
Were you playing alto then or clarinet?
Then everyone would come up and sit in?
